settings.title: Settings
settings.ratingHint: Changing the style never changes your ratings: they are stored precisely and only shown differently.
settings.name: Your name
settings.nameHint: Used in the greeting on Home. It stays on this device.

backup.title: Backup
backup.description: Saves a copy of all your records, history, tags, settings and covers in a folder you choose. Keep it somewhere safe, such as a cloud folder or an external drive.
backup.choose: Choose where to save the backup
backup.failed: The backup could not be created. Check that the folder is writable.

services.intro: Online services fill in the details and covers when you add something. Some need a free personal key.
services.privacy: Keys are stored only on this device, in credentials.toml. They are never included in backups or exports.

restore.title: Restore a backup
restore.description: Replaces all your current data with a backup made with the button above. Before doing it, Remedia saves a safety copy of your current data, so nothing is lost.
restore.confirmMessage: All your current records, history, tags and settings will be replaced with the backup in {{folder}}. A safety copy of your current data is saved first.
restore.done: Backup restored. Reload the app to see it.

errors.not_a_backup: That folder does not contain a Remedia backup. Choose the folder named "Remedia backup …".
errors.backup_from_newer_version: That backup was made with a newer version of Remedia. Update the app to restore it.
errors.failed: The backup could not be restored. Your data has not changed.
